newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Brent may pause under $20 mark after gai.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Brent may pause under $20 mark after gai.

text.p: NEARBY MONTH CLOSE * SUPPORT * RESIST * RSI-14 * MA-10 * MA-20
+ IPE Brent is likely to hold in the $19.50 to $20 a barrel range after making big gains over the past few trading sessions, said analysts.
+ Gas oil may meet resistance at $176.75 a tonne while support is seen in the range $172 to $172.50.
IPE Brent may pause for breath after jumping nearly 80 cents a barrel on Monday and nearly $2 a barrel over the past five trading sessions, said technical analysts on Tuesday.
June Brent closed at $19.72 a barrel on Monday after the whole market tipped into backwardation.
"I would expect a little bit of hesitation ahead of the $20 level," said Tony Machacek of Credit Lyonnais Rouse in London.
"But it could start to hold at higher levels," he added.
The next upside targets for Brent are $20 and then $20.84, the high set in March, said analysts.
